article.title: Asking About a Lost Item at a Train Station

paragraphs.en: Mina takes a train to work every morning. Today, she gets off at a busy station and notices that her blue umbrella is missing. She thinks she left it on the train. She remembers the line, the direction of travel, and the time she arrived. Instead of running back to the platform, she goes to the station office. She wants to ask for help and give clear information. The station employee greets her and asks what she has lost.
paragraphs.zh: 美奈每天搭火車上班。今天她在繁忙車站下車後發現藍色雨傘不見了。她認為忘在車上，記得路線、方向和抵達時間。她沒有衝回月台，而是去車站服務處，準備清楚描述遺失物。職員問她遺失了什麼。
paragraphs.ja: ミナは毎朝電車で通勤します。今日は混雑した駅で降りた後、青い傘がないことに気づきます。路線、進行方向、到着時刻を覚えています。ホームに戻る代わりに駅の窓口へ行き、駅員に事情を説明します。

paragraphs.en: Mina says, 'I think I left my umbrella on the train.' The employee asks for its color, size, and any special marks. She explains that it is dark blue and has a small white label on the handle. She also shows a photo on her phone. The employee writes down the details and checks the lost property system. He tells her that no matching umbrella has been reported yet. However, an item may be found later when the train reaches another station.
paragraphs.zh: 美奈說：「我想我把雨傘忘在火車上了。」職員詢問顏色、大小和特徵。她說是深藍色，握柄有白色標籤，並展示手機照片。職員記下資訊、查詢遺失物系統，但目前沒有符合的物品。列車抵達其他車站後仍可能有人拾獲。
paragraphs.ja: ミナは「電車に傘を忘れたと思います」と伝えます。駅員は色、大きさ、特徴を尋ねます。濃い青色で、持ち手に白いラベルがあると説明し、写真も見せます。まだ該当する届け出はありませんが、後から見つかる可能性があります。

paragraphs.en: The employee gives Mina a reference number and explains how to check again. He asks her to keep the number because it will help staff find her report. Mina asks, 'Can someone contact me if the umbrella is found?' He explains the station's contact procedure and where she can find official information. He does not promise that the umbrella will be returned. Mina checks that she has written the reference number correctly before leaving the office.
paragraphs.zh: 職員給美奈一個案件編號，說明如何再次查詢。他請她保留編號，以便找到紀錄。美奈問找到後能否聯絡她，職員解釋聯絡程序及官方資訊來源，但不保證找回。美奈離開前確認編號抄寫正確。
paragraphs.ja: 駅員は受付番号と再確認の方法を伝えます。番号があれば届け出を探しやすくなります。ミナは見つかった際の連絡方法を尋ねます。駅員は公式の案内を説明しますが、必ず戻るとは約束しません。

paragraphs.en: Two days later, Mina receives a message through the station's official process. A similar umbrella has been found. She visits the designated office with her reference number and identification. A staff member asks her to describe the umbrella again before handing it over. The white label matches her description. Mina thanks the staff for their help. She learns that giving specific details, keeping a reference number, and following the official collection procedure can make a lost item easier to recover.
paragraphs.zh: 兩天後，美奈透過車站正式程序收到通知，有人找到相似的雨傘。她帶著案件編號和身分證明前往指定服務處。職員請她再次描述物品，白色標籤符合特徵。她感謝協助，也學到詳細描述、保留編號及遵循正式領取程序的重要性。
paragraphs.ja: 二日後、公式の手続きで似た傘が見つかったと連絡が来ます。ミナは受付番号と身分証明書を持って指定窓口へ行きます。特徴を再確認してから受け取り、駅員に感謝します。具体的な説明と番号の保管が役立つと学びます。
